full_name: Daily and Sports Activities Data Set
preprocessing_note: Raw DSADS files contain accelerometer, gyroscope, and magnetometer for five body positions. The current project drops magnetometer channels and keeps acc+gyro only, producing 30 channels per window.
available_feature_types: physical HAR features including AI, VI, SMA_phys, EVA, CAGH, AVG, AVH, ARATG, DF, ENERGY_phys, AAE, and ARE
activity_label_order: walking on a treadmill with a speed of 4 km/h (in flat)
walking on a treadmill with a speed of 4 km/h (in 15 deg inclined positions)
running on a treadmill with a speed of 8 km/h
cycling on an exercise bike in horizontal positions
cycling on an exercise bike in vertical positions
note: Use only the five body-worn IMU positions and acc/gyro observability. Do not assume video, GPS, magnetometer features, object identity, room context, or subject identity.
